name: LangChain
shortDescription: Open-source libraries for agents, chains, and tool calling, plus optional LangSmith traces.
longDescription: LangChain is a set of libraries for composing agent and tool-calling workflows. LangSmith, the tracing product on the same site, is separate: the pricing page we read listed a $0 developer plan and a paid Plus plan. We imported the Python package locally and did not call a model.
freeTierNotes: OSS libraries free. LangSmith Developer plan $0/seat with up to 5k base traces/mo then pay-as-you-go.
bestFor: Developers composing agent workflows in code
Teams that want run traces via LangSmith
notIdealFor: People who want only a visual builder
smokeTestNotes: Install/import only; no API key, no LLM invoke, no signup.

handsOn.detail: pip install + import langchain; from langchain.agents import create_agent
